findings.title: UI test step 3 uses app.maps.firstMatch, which passes vacuously because the Map tab's map is still in the hierarchy; use the market-location-map identifier deterministically and count pins within it
UI test step 5 Back button query (navigationBars.buttons.element(boundBy: 0)) is ambiguous and fails on macOS; query by label or make the test iOS-only
MarketLocationMapView init for @State position is not specified
Mark SingleMarketMap.Pin nonisolated explicitly (default actor isolation is MainActor)
everyIconResolves is UIKit-only and does not run on macOS
Remove the 'Responses to design review' process section from the design
External map item behavior (Req 2.2) is covered only manually; state this explicitly
